I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I said I'd noted 16 August as an unverified, overheard date. I also said I couldn't confirm it from anything she can see, and that it needs checking with the Tamsin account owner or Finance.

- **Not shared:** My stored Tamsin deadlines (26 July, earlier 21 March and 14 December 2026) all come from Ilse Varga's posts in #north-team and #north-random. Pree isn't in either channel, so I didn't mention them.
- **Memory:** I added her 16 August report to the Tamsin memory as an unverified rumour, not as a correction. The current record is still 26 July, which has never been checked against Finance's sheet, so the deadline is still unconfirmed.
